help: Dial banks for the Develop Dial. All four dials page together: tap a dial's strip for the next bank.
Each bank lists up to 4 slots, left to right; null is an empty dial. The plugin reads this file when it starts,
so restart the plugin after editing. If anything here is invalid, the plugin uses its built-in banks instead and
Slot fields: param (an LrDevelopController name such as Exposure), label (shown on the strip), step (value units
per tick; a number or a fraction such as "1/30"), fine (per tick during push + turn; default step / 4),
precision (decimal places shown), unit (shown after the value), signed (a + on positive values).
kelvin overrides those fields while Lightroom reports a Kelvin range for the param: Temperature on raw and DNG files.
acceleration is k in effective ticks = ticks x (1 + k x (|ticks| - 1)), per dial event; 0 turns it off.
